text: せいかい　すると　ドアが　あいて　つぎへ　すすめます！

structure.jp: つぎへ　すすめます！
structure.en: you can move on to the next!

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means that whenever that happens, the next thing follows for sure. せいかい　すると = 'if you answer correctly'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: すすむ 'move on' changes to すすめる to mean 'can move on'. つぎへ　すすめます = 'you can move on to the next'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins this action to the next one, like 'and'. ドアが　あいて = 'the door opens and'.
